name: PDF.ai
tagline: PDF.ai is a document chat tool that lets you upload PDFs and ask questions, get summaries, and extract specific information through a conversational interface. Researchers, lawyers, and students use it to quickly pull facts from dense documents without reading them in full. It handles multi-document uploads so you can ask questions that span across several files at once.
